summary.text: Sharif Street is a Democrat who represents Pennsylvania's 3rd Senatorial District in part of Philadelphia and is the Democratic (minority) chair of the Senate Banking & Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Street is an attorney who graduated cum laude from Morehouse College with a B.A. in business administration with a concentration in finance, and from the University of Pennsylvania Law School in 1999.

His official biography lists membership in the American, Pennsylvania, Philadelphia and National Bar Associations; work as managing director of the Housing Association of Delaware Valley and as chief legislative advisor to the Democratic chair of the Housing and Urban Development Committee; and co-founding the non-profit Urban Solution. He is married to April Street and they have five children.
